history.summary: An in-town Hanuman shrine in Motihari, documented on a local map listing at 26.640146, 84.902855 with daily hours 9 AM-8 PM (corroboration thin; exact shrine coordinates approximate). The CSV's generic 'Hanuman Mandir' is ambiguous: several other Hanuman temples exist around Motihari (Dhaka/Kathmalia, Raghunathpur, Sugaon, Chapra Bahas), so this file uses the most central in-town referent with that ambiguity flagged. No founding date, dynasty, or founder is documented.

name: Hanuman Mandir
town_description: Motihari is the headquarters of East Champaran district in northern Bihar. The town is best known as the birthplace of writer George Orwell (1903) and sits on the East-West Corridor (NH-27) near the Nepal border.

travel.airport: Darbhanga Airport (~140 km) or Patna (~170 km); distances approximate
travel.railway: Bapudham Motihari station, on the Barauni-Gorakhpur line, in the town
travel.road: NH-27 (East-West Corridor) passes through Motihari; local auto-rickshaws and taxis in town

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Tuesdays and Hanuman Jayanti are the busiest
visitor_information.opening_hours: 9:00 AM-8:00 PM daily (per one local listing; verify on arrival)
